pdb_path.description: Path to the input PDB structure that PyRosetta will score, relax, pack, or analyze.

candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream structure tool. Promotes the first item's structure_path into `pdb_path` when omitted.

mode.description: Operation to perform: `score` = REF2015 total_score; `interface` = InterfaceAnalyzerMover metrics (requires `chains_a`+`chains_b`); `relax` = FastRelax energy minimization; `pack` = pack_rotamers side-chain repacking.

chains_a.description: First side of the binding interface as a chain-id string (e.g. `A` or `AB`). Required for `mode=interface`.

chains_b.description: Second side of the binding interface (chain ids). Required for `mode=interface`.

max_relax_cycles.description: FastRelax cycle count (relax mode only). More cycles improve relaxation at proportional cost.

seed.description: Random seed forwarded to PyRosetta's `-constant_seed -jran` init flags. Affects sidecar selection.
